_comment: outDir, rootDir, include and exclude belong to the package, never to the shared
tsconfig: a relative path written in an extended file resolves from
lib.json carries isolatedDeclarations and stableTypeOrdering — the two options
that make the published .d.ts readable by TypeScript 6 and 7 alike. This package
is the third consumer of that guarantee and the one it matters most for: a DTO
schema's inferred type is exactly the kind of thing isolatedDeclarations refuses
to let cross a package boundary un-annotated.
